sample: 03 · CI-required mission (evidence bundle must include a finished Actions run)
purpose: Same lifecycle as sample 02, but the sponsor froze CI evidence in — the bundle without a CI kind is refused client-side and on-chain, and examination returns NOT_READY while the run is still in progress.

openMissionForm.Problem statement: CSV exports corrupt quoted fields containing embedded newlines. Repair parsing so embedded LF and CRLF round-trip losslessly; the official CI for the exact candidate SHA must be green.

criteria.text: Quoted CSV fields containing LF round-trip without data loss.
Quoted CSV fields containing CRLF round-trip without data loss.
The repository Actions run for the candidate SHA completed successfully.

openMissionForm.Scope policy: Changes may touch src/csv/**, tests/csv/** and .github/workflows/** only.
openMissionForm.Forbidden changes: No dependency replacement, no public API removal, no unrelated refactoring.
openMissionForm.Evidence policy: Commit page + .diff of the candidate, plus the GitHub Actions run page bound to the exact candidate SHA.

commitPanel.Candidate commit SHA: <fix SHA with a passing Actions run>

evidence.note: Actions run completed green for the exact candidate SHA

commitPanel.negativeDrill: Remove the CI row and press Commit → the client stops you before any signature. Then commit while the run is orange: examination should return NOT_READY and refund the bond; re-commit after the run goes green.

expectedFlow.artifactExamination: VERIFIED only when the run page shows completion; otherwise NOT_READY with a bond refund.
expectedFlow.criterionReview: QUALIFIED requires C3's CI proof in addition to the code criteria.
